mentions.name: Life Story Interviewer App
mentions.description: This app acts as a personal interviewer, guiding users through their memories and helping them write and share their life stories with loved ones. It is aimed at older adults, with visual presentation and typography of the stories central to the experience. The author has a working prototype for testing the interview flow, plans to share it with friends and family for feedback, and is looking for a designer to collaborate on the next phase.
mentions.problem: Writing your life story feels too overwhelming; people who enjoy reminiscing struggle to organize their thoughts into a coherent narrative, and their stories risk never being passed down.
mentions.audience: Older adults who enjoy reminiscing but struggle to organize their thoughts into a coherent narrative; stories are meant to be shared with family members and future generations.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Have you ever wanted to write your life story but found it too overwhelming? I’m developing an app that acts as your personal interviewer, guiding you through your memories and helping you share them with your loved ones.

The app is designed for older adults who enjoy reminiscing but struggle to organize their thoughts into a coherent narrative.
